name: Jaihind Industries Limited
about: Jaihind Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing, dealing, brokering, agency, distribution, dyeing, printing, and bleaching textile fibers, yarn, cloth, cotton, woolen, worsted materials, silk, garments, and handicrafts in India. It also undertakes twisting, doubling, texturizing, and crimping of polyester yarn, silk, cotton, and blended yarn. In addition, the company is involved in healthcare and hospital-related business. Further, the company exports its products. The company was formerly known as Jaihind Synthetics Limited and changed its name to Jaihind Industries Limited in February 2026. Jaihind Industries Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.
